question: What subtle nectar practice affects even the wise practitioner internally?
premises: There is a tip of nectar
It involves the essence of juice
Even the wise are affected by it
inference: A subtle internal nectar process acts powerfully, even on the wise.
uncertainties: The exact physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is esoteric.
plain_english: Even the wise one is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of the juice.
